features.description: Effect.ts dependencies are installed and available for import throughout the codebase
steps: Open a TypeScript file and verify 'import { Effect } from "effect"' resolves
features.verification: grep -q '"effect"' package.json && grep -q '@effect/platform' package.json && grep -q '@effect/platform-bun' package.json

features.description: ConfigError is defined as a tagged error with variable and message fields
steps: Check it has 'variable: string' and 'message: string' fields
features.verification: test -f src/errors/index.ts && grep -q 'class ConfigError' src/errors/index.ts && grep -q 'Data.TaggedError' src/errors/index.ts

features.description: DockerError is defined with command, exitCode, stderr, and cause fields
steps: Check it has command, exitCode?, stderr?, cause? fields

features.description: ContainerNotFoundError is defined with container field for missing container scenarios
ClaudeError is defined with exitCode, stderr, and cause fields for CLI failures
steps: Check it has exitCode?, stderr?, cause? fields

features.description: TimeoutError is defined with operation and durationMs fields for timeout scenarios
steps: Check it has 'operation: string' and 'durationMs: number' fields

features.description: GitError is defined with operation union type and optional stderr/cause fields
steps: Check operation field is typed as union of git operations

features.description: FeatureError, CircuitBreakerError, StreamError, and ValidationError are all defined
steps: Verify all four error classes exist with correct TaggedError definitions
Check each has appropriate fields per spec
features.verification: grep -q 'class FeatureError' src/errors/index.ts && grep -q 'class CircuitBreakerError' src/errors/index.ts && grep -q 'class StreamError' src/errors/index.ts && grep -q 'class ValidationError' src/errors/index.ts

features.description: RalphError union type exports all error types for comprehensive error handling
steps: Verify 'export type RalphError = ConfigError | DockerError | ...' exists
Check all 10 error types are included in the union

features.description: Directory structure is created for services, layers, and streams modules
features.verification: test -d src/services && test -d src/layers && test -d src/streams
